independence.title: Provider CLI Independence
text: Symvoulio does not embed, proxy, resell, or provide access to Anthropic Claude Code or OpenAI Codex.
Claude Code and Codex are separately installed command-line applications. Users authenticate directly with each provider through the provider's official CLI login flow.
Symvoulio orchestrates local commands authorized by the user and exchanges user-selected files between isolated local workspaces.

The application does not store provider passwords, browser cookies, or authentication tokens in its settings or files, and does not read the providers' credential files. Terminal input, including anything typed or pasted during provider login, passes through the app's memory to the provider's CLI.

win.title: Windows: why you may see a warning
win.why: The Windows installer is not code-signed yet, and a new download has no reputation with Microsoft. Windows may therefore warn before it runs. Microsoft describes SmartScreen this way:
win.smartscreen: «If a URL, a file, an app, or a certificate has an established reputation, users don't see any warnings. If there's no reputation, the item is marked as a higher risk and presents a warning to the user.»
win.dialog: The dialog reads «Windows protected your PC». Choose More info, then Run anyway — only for an installer whose SHA-256 checksum matches the one on the release page.
win.sac: «Malware, Potentially Unwanted Apps (PUA), and unknown, unsigned code are blocked by default.» — Microsoft, on Smart App Control. With Smart App Control on, an unsigned installer cannot run and there is no Run anyway.
win.checksum: Sources: Microsoft Learn, Microsoft Defender SmartScreen overview and Smart App Control overview.

mac.title: macOS: why the first launch is blocked
mac.why: This version is signed ad hoc, not with an Apple Developer ID, and is not notarized by Apple. macOS therefore refuses the first launch and says that Apple could not verify the app.
mac.steps: Close the warning with Done. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, and under Security click Open Anyway next to the message about Symvoulio (the button stays for about an hour). Enter your login password, click OK, then Open. Do this only for a download whose SHA-256 checksum matches the one on the release page.
mac.source: Source: Apple, «Open a Mac app from an unknown developer» (Mac User Guide).
